products.name: Helicone
products.note: Proxy-based LLM observability and gateway: one base-URL change for logging, caching, rate limiting; in maintenance mode since the March 2026 Mintlify acquisition

profile_text.body:
Helicone is an LLM observability and AI gateway platform whose website describes it as "the LLMOps platform behind the fastest-growing AI companies," offering routing and monitoring tools for AI applications. The core product, also called Helicone, works as a proxy-based gateway that developers integrate through a single base-URL change, gaining capabilities including logging, caching, and rate limiting across large language model calls.

Helicone was acquired by Mintlify in March 2026, and the product has been in maintenance mode since that acquisition. No litigation, MCP server registrations, or SEC or patent filings appear in the available records.
